  "title": "Production Supervisor",
  "description": "Godrej Consumer Products Limited (GCPL) is the largest homegrown &#39;Home and Personal Care&#39; company in India, with a turnover of more than 1.3 billion USD and growing at 25% + CAGR. We are constantly innovating to delight our consumers with more exciting, superior quality products at affordable prices.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Production Supervisor

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time (On-site)

Job Purpose


	To supervise daily production activities and ensure the efficient manufacturing of products in accordance with established quality, safety, and productivity standards.
	The incumbent will oversee production operations, monitor manufacturing processes, manage production personnel, and apply chemical knowledge to ensure product consistency and process optimization.


Key Responsibilities
Production Operations:


	Supervise and coordinate production activities to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
	Ensure adherence to approved manufacturing processes, formulations, and operating procedures.
	Monitor production performance and implement corrective actions to address operational challenges.
	Ensure optimal utilization of manpower, machinery, and raw materials.
	Coordinate shift activities and ensure smooth handover between shifts.
	Minimize production downtime and wastage.


Process Monitoring &amp; Control:


	Monitor critical process parameters to ensure product quality and process efficiency.
	Investigate process deviations and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
	Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at increasing productivity and reducing costs.
	Participate in process validation and optimization projects.


Quality Assurance:


	Ensure compliance with quality standards, GMP requirements, and company procedures.
	Monitor in-process quality checks and ensure products meet required specifications.
	Liaise with the Quality Assurance team on product quality issues and corrective actions.
	Review production records and ensure accurate documentation.


Team Leadership:


	Supervise production operators and technicians.
	Assign duties and monitor employee performance.
	Conduct on-the-job training and coaching for team members.
	Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
	Address employee grievances and escalate issues where necessary.


Health, Safety &amp; Environment:


	Ensure strict compliance with all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies.
	Promote safe working practices and the proper use of PPE.
	Conduct routine safety inspections and identify potential hazards.
	Participate in incident investigations and implement corrective measures.


Inventory &amp; Resource Management:


	Monitor raw material consumption and production yields.
	Ensure proper handling, storage, and utilization of production materials.
	Coordinate with Stores and Supply Chain teams to prevent material shortages.
	Monitor and report production waste.


Reporting &amp; Documentation:


	Prepare and submit production reports.
	Maintain accurate records of production activities, downtime, quality deviations, and material usage.
	Analyze production data and provide recommendations for operational improvements.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Production target achievement (%)
	Production efficiency (%)
	Machine downtime (%)
	Product quality compliance rate
	Material yield and wastage levels
	Safety compliance score
	Number of quality deviations
	Team productivity and attendance
	Cost reduction and process improvement initiatives


Education &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or a related science discipline.
	Minimum of 4-7 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in FMCG, personal care, food, pharmaceutical, or chemical industries.
	At least 1-2 years in a supervisory role.


Competencies:
Technical Competencies:


	Production Planning and Control
	Manufacturing Process Management
	Process Optimization
	Quality Management Systems (ISO, GMP)
	Root Cause Analysis
	Health &amp; Safety Compliance
	Data Analysis and Reporting
	Microsoft Office Applications


Behavioral Competencies:


	Leadership and Team Management
	Problem Solving
	Communication Skills
	Decision Making
	Attention to Detail
	Results Orientation
	Time Management
	Continuous Improvement Mindset

Production Supervisor Job at Godrej Consumer Products Limited




        
    

        
        Godrej Consumer Products Limited (GCPL) is the largest homegrown 'Home and Personal Care' company in India, with a turnover of more than 1.3 billion USD and growing at 25% + CAGR. We are constantly innovating to delight our consumers with more exciting, superior quality products at affordable prices.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Production Supervisor

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time (On-site)

Job Purpose
     

            
    




	To supervise daily production activities and ensure the efficient manufacturing of products in accordance with established quality, safety, and productivity standards.
	The incumbent will oversee production operations, monitor manufacturing processes, manage production personnel, and apply chemical knowledge to ensure product consistency and process optimization.


Key Responsibilities
Production Operations:


	Supervise and coordinate production activities to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
	Ensure adherence to approved manufacturing processes, formulations, and operating procedures.
	Monitor production performance and implement corrective actions to address operational challenges.
	Ensure optimal utilization of manpower, machinery, and raw materials.
	Coordinate shift activities and ensure smooth handover between shifts.
	Minimize production downtime and wastage.


Process Monitoring & Control:


	Monitor critical process parameters to ensure product quality and process efficiency.
	Investigate process deviations and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
	Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at increasing productivity and reducing costs.
	Participate in process validation and optimization projects.


Quality Assurance:


	Ensure compliance with quality standards, GMP requirements, and company procedures.
	Monitor in-process quality checks and ensure products meet required specifications.
	Liaise with the Quality Assurance team on product quality issues and corrective actions.
	Review production records and ensure accurate documentation.


Team Leadership:


	Supervise production operators and technicians.
	Assign duties and monitor employee performance.
	Conduct on-the-job training and coaching for team members.
	Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
	Address employee grievances and escalate issues where necessary.


Health, Safety & Environment:


	Ensure strict compliance with all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies.
	Promote safe working practices and the proper use of PPE.
	Conduct routine safety inspections and identify potential hazards.
	Participate in incident investigations and implement corrective measures.


Inventory & Resource Management:


	Monitor raw material consumption and production yields.
	Ensure proper handling, storage, and utilization of production materials.
	Coordinate with Stores and Supply Chain teams to prevent material shortages.
	Monitor and report production waste.


Reporting & Documentation:


	Prepare and submit production reports.
	Maintain accurate records of production activities, downtime, quality deviations, and material usage.
	Analyze production data and provide recommendations for operational improvements.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Production target achievement (%)
	Production efficiency (%)
	Machine downtime (%)
	Product quality compliance rate
	Material yield and wastage levels
	Safety compliance score
	Number of quality deviations
	Team productivity and attendance
	Cost reduction and process improvement initiatives


Education & Experience


	Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or a related science discipline.
	Minimum of 4-7 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in FMCG, personal care, food, pharmaceutical, or chemical industries.
	At least 1-2 years in a supervisory role.


Competencies:
Technical Competencies:


	Production Planning and Control
	Manufacturing Process Management
	Process Optimization
	Quality Management Systems (ISO, GMP)
	Root Cause Analysis
	Health & Safety Compliance
	Data Analysis and Reporting
	Microsoft Office Applications


Behavioral Competencies:


	Leadership and Team Management
	Problem Solving
	Communication Skills
	Decision Making
	Attention to Detail
	Results Orientation
	Time Management
	Continuous Improvement Mindset
